question: Substances that can be broken down by biological process are called:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Biodegradable substances.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Biodegradable substances **are those that can be broken down by **natural biological** processes into harmless substances like **water, carbon dioxide, and minerals.**
 
• These substances are typically derived from **plant or animal sources **and are easily decomposed by **microorganisms** present in the environment.
 
• Biodegradable substances are considered **environmentally friendly** as they do not contribute to **pollution and waste accumulation.**
 
• Examples of biodegradable substances include **food waste, paper, and certain plastics** that are made from natural materials like **cornstarch or vegetable oil. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Toxic substances **are **harmful chemicals** that can cause **damage** to living organisms and the environment.

 
 
• These substances **cannot be broken **down by natural processes and can accumulate in the environment over time, leading to serious **health and environmental problems.**
 
 
 
• **Non-biodegradable substances** are materials that **cannot be broken down** by natural processes and can persist in the environment for hundreds or even thousands of years.
 
 
• Examples include **plastics, glass, and certain metals.**
 
• These substances contribute to **waste accumulation and pollution**.
 
 
 
• **Chemical substances **refer to any substance made up of** chemical elements or compounds. **
